pages.text: Starts waiting; select Search. It approaches same-owner or mutually shared injured companions and Broken Slime Blocks in its fixed area, prioritizing revival. It can also heal itself. Supply slimeballs in its own usable bag. Detection Range is always twice the common value, initially 16 blocks.

Each successful treatment costs one slimeball and one stamina: up to four health healed, or revival at one health. Full health, cancelled healing, blocked placement, invalid data, or duplicate identity costs nothing. Missing balls request supply.
